Generally x-only filters see log only up to sign. (3) Bound is vacuous for D >~ sqrt(r)/log, so it does not close the polynomial sub-case of KN-OPEN-91d4f6 for high degree, only D=polylog. (4) Non-genericity: claim is an obstruction only; any statement of form 'low-degree x-functional is uncorrelated with log' is consistent with CGK/generic-group bound and adds no B*D^2<N route.
